Supplementary Tables (S1-S5) of the paper could not be downloaded; the sample map was reconstructed from deposited txt-zip tables and MaxQuant summaries.

TiO2 and proteome file-number to rat-number link is by ordinal (T_N / PROTEOME_N = Rat N): confirmed for proteome by the Perseus export (E_01,03,05,06,09,11,13,15 = experiment 1 rat set) and for pTyr by summary counts; TiO2 workbook carries the same Rat 1-16 / experiment 1-2 layout but no raw-name key.
QE3_pTyr_1 and QE3_pTyr_15 have identical peptide counts (10417), so Ctrl_7b vs EGF_1b assignment follows the numbering pattern, not an independent check.
